brls:Label.text: 1. A folder named `mod_alchemy` now exists on your SD root. In 'mod_alchemy', create a folder. Give that folder the name of a game's Title ID you want to mod. You can find title IDs of games at nswdb.com

2. In the folder you created in step 1, create a folder for each 'group' you wish to categorize your mods in. Some typical examples of names you may want to use would be 'Characters', 'Levels', 'Music', etc.

3. In each of those folders created in step 2, create a folder for each thing you want to mod in the game. For example, if you have a mod that would replace Mario in a game, you would want to create a folder named 'Mario' in a folder like 'mod_alchemy/[-PUT-TITLE-ID-HERE-]/Characters/'. Then create folders for the names of any other characters you have mods for in the 'Characters' folder.

4. In each of those folders created in step 3, create a folder for each mod you have. For example, if you have a mod that replaces Mario with Spongebob, you would want to created a folder named 'Spongebob' in a folder like 'mod_alchemy/[-PUT-TITLE-ID-HERE-]/Characters/Mario/'. Then create folders for the names of any other mods you have that replace Mario in the 'Mario' folder.

5. In each of those folders created in step 4, place the folders and files for each mod in each folder. For example, if you have a mod that replaces Mario with Spongebob, you would want to place the folder structure for the 'Spongebob' mod in a folder like 'mod_alchemy/[-PUT-TITLE-ID-HERE-]/Characters/Mario/Spongebob/'. In most cases, a mod's file structure should start with a folder named 'romfs', so there should be a 'mod_alchemy/[-PUT-TITLE-ID-HERE-]/Characters/Mario/Spongebob/romfs/' folder which would then contain the rest of the folders and files that make up the mod. The folder structure should match the game's folders and files.

6. Remove any files that are currently in the '/atmosphere/contents/[-PUT-TITLE-ID-HERE-]/' folder that may conflict with files from any mods that you set up in step 5. If you want to keep them, move them to a mod folder within 'mod_alchemy' created in the manner described in steps 2-5. If you don't feel very sure of what you're doing, it's a good idea to create a backup of '/atmosphere/contents/[-PUT-TITLE-ID-HERE-]/'.
7. It is highly recommended to create a proper backup. See 'Backups'.
8. You're ready to use Simple Mod Alchemist!
